methodology: Prepared by the implementation AI from pinned manufacturer documents before any source-extractor model runs. All 30 held-out devices are separated by device family from the 30 development candidates. Exact typed value/unit/scope agreement is measured against this unreviewed draft, not accuracy or independently adjudicated source support. Negative and unknown cases are included. Quotes are retained privately; the public reference stores source hashes, page offsets, and excerpt hashes. Two independent human technical reviewers are still required. No physical tests are represented.
